Name: XerDrake's Clint Refined and Improved (Maybe)
Author: XerDrake
Description:
[center][size=5][b][color=#9fc5e8]Good day peeps![/color][/b]
[/size][size=3]
This mod replaces the sprite of your hopeless romantic blacksmith with a more enhanced* version that I guarantee may or may not satisfy your taste.[/size][size=2] [color=#f4f4f4][i]See what I did there[/i][/color][/size]
[size=3] No promises![/size]

[size=3]*Of course this is subjective, if you prefer the original sprite then good for ya!
[color=#e06666]
[/color][/size][b][color=#cc4125]*UPDATE! 09/June/2018*[/color][/b]
Added portraits!
[b][i]Content Patcher[/i][/b] version is available and so is the [b][i]regular XNB[/i][/b].
A higher resolution version is also available for those who wants it (This [i]requires[/i] the [b]Portraiture mod[/b] made by [b]Platonymus[/b])
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Here's[/url]﻿ the link to the Nexus mod page if you are interested.

[b][size=4][color=#ff7700]Installation:[/color]
[/size]Manual (No mods required):[/b]
Locate your Stardew Valley directory.
It is recommended to save a back up file of the Clint.xnb file from the folder "Characters". ( Content/Characters )
Unzip or extract the [i].xnb[/i] file after downloading.
Place the file into the folder "Characters"[i].

[/i][b]Content Patcher:
[/b]Locate your Stardew Valley directory.
Ensure that SMAPI is installed. (Any version above 2.0 should work)
Ensure that Content Patcher is installed. (Minimum version is 1.3.0)
Unzip or extract the .zip file after downloading.
Place the file into the mod folder.
(Optional) Change the config.json according to your taste.
